segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report the pads hydrate and calm the skin without over-drying, including one who calls it a miracle for clearing stubborn cystic acne without the dryness her other treatments caused.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin, including one managing rosacea, report the pads are calming and non-irritating even with daily use, though two reviewers with sensitive skin report breakouts or purging on the chin and forehead and one developed small red bumps she attributes to the rougher pad texture.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally report balanced, non-stripped results, though one with mostly-dry combination skin developed new cystic acne after her third use, which she linked to pairing the pads with a heavier moisturizer rather than the pads alone.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads control oil and reduce shedding sebum through the day while still leaving skin hydrated rather than stripped, which several found surprising for an exfoliating toner.
segments.mature: The two reviewers who describe their skin as maturing report the pads leave it refreshed, balanced, and well hydrated.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe the pads as strongly hydrating even though they exfoliate, including oily-skin reviewers surprised not to feel dried out afterward; one reviewer using them specifically for dehydrated skin saw only a slight, non-dramatic improvement.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report calmer, less red skin, including reduced redness around pimples, cheeks, and the nose within days of starting use; however, one reviewer with sensitive skin developed small red bumps covering most of her face after about a week and suspected the pads were the cause.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with combination or compromised skin report the pads do not strip the skin barrier, and one specifically credits them with repairing a barrier that felt disrupted.
concerns.spots: Reviewers dealing with discoloration, uneven tone, or age spots report gradual brightening and a more even complexion with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report calmer, clearer skin with fewer breakouts and reduced blackheads or whiteheads, including cases described as hormonal or stubborn cystic acne; however, three reviewers report the opposite — new cystic acne on the cheeks and chin, breakouts and purging on the chin and forehead, or closed comedones appearing after regular use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads control excess oil and sebum, particularly around the T-zone, without leaving skin feeling stripped or dry.

extraits.titre: Be careful with what moisturizer you use
extraits.texte: These pads were good in the beginning (1-3 days) and I love the first two times I used them. This is obviously not an everyday use, as the AHA can cause purging and strip your skin if used too frequently. After the third time I used them, I noticed I had thick cystic acne appearing mainly in my cheeks and chin. I have combo mostly dry skin, so having acne in these areas isn't all that new. I switched my moisturizer from the La Roche Posay no SPF to Tatcha water cream when using this and the acne went away. I've noticed that if you use any thick or medium thickness moisturizer, it will give you cystic acne like no tomorrow. Be vary wary of fragrances too as I got chemical burns from using this with other moisturizers as well and it is not from misuse as I have been using AHAs for years with these moisturizers and haven't had these issues. Could be from a higher concentration in this product, but overall would not repurchase.

extraits.titre: A Simplification of a Usually Messy Skincare Step
extraits.texte: The ANUA Heartleaf Toner pad was a great way for me to include a toner into my routine without the fuss. The target of this Toner + Pad duo was to combine the benefits of both a hydrating Toner & Exfoliation by effectively trying to make possible that more reactive skin types get the benefits of exfoliation. The key ingredients of PHAs(PolyHydroxy Acids), Heartleaf, and Madecassoside aimed to give a gentle but effective exfoliating experience. The pads themselves don't carry a lot of product; but if you tip the container upside down then they'll be an even distribution of product on the most immediate pads. I used this every two days, because while the molecular weight of the exfoliating agents are larger than say your more known BHAs & AHAs. You can still overdo it especially with the added element of the physical property of the pad itself if you don't rub gently enough. The product on application leaves a tacky feel that I disliked, even so it doesn't interfere with follow up skin care steps. I'm using this my skin did get a reduction of redness from a new pimple. It immediately soothed the inflammation around my pimple and the texture (from old pitted scars/pores) was still there but slightly less obvious. I've been using this on my cheeks/neck/hands for the last week. In doing so I did notice I got Closed Comedones on my chin + cheeks. So I would say if you're prone to that test this out as there are fatty alcohols in here.

I started off loving this product because I noticed a definite increase in hydration and moisture in my skin while using it. The solution on the pads feels like a big drink of water for your face! It is very lightweight and absorbs within seconds. I do wish that the cotton pads used in the product were a bit softer. I found them to be quite rough and abrasive and having sensitive skin, I don't tend to use physical exfoliators. After using this product for a week, I started to notice some small red bumps covering most of my face. I hadn't switched or added anything else in my skincare routine during that time so I have to assume that the heart leaf pads are what caused it. I may try just dabbing the pads on my face instead of rubbing them in to see if that prevents the irritation.

I have struggled with acne since puberty. It seems to get worse the older i get. I have adult cystic acne, but its very hard to treat because my skin is SO dry. This product is a miracle worker! It cleanses, exfoliates, and tones WITHOUT drying me out! My subaceous fillaments are more subtle, and my redness is reduced. My skin has cleared beautifully, and FAST. I had minimal purging. I have very sensitive skin and no reaction. (I also have lupus if that helps anyone decide to purchase.)

Anua is the first Korean skincare brand I've ever tried, and it has quickly become my absolute favorite since 2022. The Heartleaf 77 Clear Pad is a game-changer for my oily skin type. These pads are the best solution for cleaning, toning, refreshing, soothing, and hydrating the skin—all in one simple step. The gentle yet effective formula leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh without any harshness or irritation. It tones and hydrates perfectly, helping to balance oil production while soothing redness. The heartleaf extract in the formula is incredibly calming, and the lightweight texture ensures my skin feels refreshed and never sticky. For anyone looking for a versatile and reliable skincare product, this is it. ANUA has truly set the bar high for me when it comes to Korean skincare!

Received complimentary for review. The ANUA Hearleaf 77 Clear Pads are amazing. I will start by saying that I have dry maturing skin and these felt absolutely amazing. I really like how sanitary the packaging is. There are tongs included right on the top to grab the pads which I really like. It makes getting the pads sanitary and easy. Also a great option if sharing the pads with a partner. The pads themselves have a great amount of product on them. They feel instantly cooling upon application. My skin felt calm and hydrating during application and after application. My skin felt extremely hydrated and remained that way hours after application. I am a huge fan of these pads. I would recommend these for use to anyone, regardless of age I think these would be beneficial for anyone embracing skincare.
